text: In this unit Alex, Lena and Max plan a trip to Munich, and you will plan a holiday: where to go, when, for how long, what the weather will be like and where to stay. You will compare places and make suggestions and say what you would like. The scenes are set in places you may know: a travel agency, a student club, a hotel desk and a phone call to the tourist office.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
